The room continues visibly outside both glass sidewalls; neither sidewall is masonry. A clearly outlined low stone shower base and glass top edges make this three-sided geometry unmistakable. This general U category cover has CLOSED front glazing, quiet silver hinges and a simple vertical handle, no sliding track.
